audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was given to Kennen although whys[1] says 'neither side wins the trade outright yet'; Level 6 was 'Skill' although whys[4] calls it 'your single biggest window'; two items was Kennen although whys[6] and spikes[3] say a resisted Poppy eats the stun window and wins the duel.
audit.why: 49.55% over 220 games is dead even overall, but the stages are not: Kennen owns 3, 6 and first item, Poppy owns the late once Mercs and Force of Nature are up. The packet chart matches.
audit.corrected: L1 Skill, L2 Skill, L3 Kennen, Levels 4-5 Skill, L6 Kennen, first item Kennen, 2+ items Poppy.

audit.why: Spikes sit right: Kennen at 2-3, at 6 and at first item, Poppy late. Keeper's Verdict is 140/120/100s against Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s, so Kennen has an ult for more fights than she does until her rank 3.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; spikes[1] text extended with the channel interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places describe a 'Q-knockup' chained off her wall pin. Hammer Shock has no knockup — it damages and leaves a slowing zone that explodes after a delay. The only knockup in the kit is Keeper's Verdict (R). The text also never mentions that her R is an interruptible channel or that Iron Ambassador gives her a pickup shield.
audit.why: Riot text: Q Hammer Shock, 430 range, 8/7/6/5/4s, damage plus a slow zone that explodes; E Heroic Charge, 475 range, 14/13/12/11/10s, dash that stuns only when the target hits a wall; R Keeper's Verdict, 140/120/100s, channelled knockback carrying channel and untargetable flags; P Iron Ambassador, a buckler she picks up for a shield. The missingInteractions rules channel-interruptible, untargetable-dodges-burst and shield-absorbs-burst all apply.
audit.corrected: Her follow-up is a Hammer Shock slow zone, not a knockup; her R is a channel your third Mark of the Storm cancels outright, and her passive shield should be forced out before you commit burst.

audit.why: Heroic Charge at 14s rank 1 is correctly identified as the cooldown to track, and Steadfast Presence at 20s rank 1 does nothing to Kennen because Lightning Rush is a movement form rather than a dash she can stop.
audit.corrected: Added the 14s figure so the tracking advice is concrete.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Poppy carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Mercs and Force of Nature let her survive your R and pin you to a wall — peel in teamfights, never sidelane-duel her.

edits.before: You keep the poke edge, but if she catches you near a wall her E-pin into Q-knockup out-trades your low-HP body, so you respect and chip.
edits.after: You keep the poke edge, but near a wall her Heroic Charge (14s) pins and stuns you into a Hammer Shock zone, so respect and chip.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom unlocks your Q-W-E-Flash-R stun-lock; if her E and W are down you blow her up before she pins you to a wall.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom unlocks your stun-lock, and a mark landing mid-Keeper's Verdict cancels the channel — her R never leaves the ground.

edits.before: Poppy's W (the dash-block bubble) is wasted against you — you never have to dash to fight, so just sit at Q range and chip. Her only real threat early is E: if you hug a wall she can pin you against it for a stun and follow with the Q knockup, so fight in the open lane where E only does its short dashless version. Don't waste E (Lightning Rush) chasing her; she has no dash to punish anyway, and you want it up for her engage.
edits.after: Poppy's W (Steadfast Presence) is wasted against you — Lightning Rush is not a dash for it to stop, so sit at Q range and chip. Her real threat is Heroic Charge (E, 475 range, 14s at rank 1): hug a wall and she pins you against it for a stun into a Hammer Shock slow zone, so fight in the open lane where that E only shoves you back. Don't spend Lightning Rush chasing her; you want it up for her engage.

edits.before: This stretch is a poke war you win on the scoreboard but not the all-in. Keep stacking marks with Q and Electrical Surge autos, but respect her E — getting wall-pinned mid-trade flips the fight, since she chains E-pin into Q-knockup and out-trades your fragile body. At 6 your Slicing Maelstrom is the spike: when her E and W are both down, Q-W-E-Flash-R stun-locks her before she can pin you, and your magic burst ignores the armor she rushed.
edits.after: This stretch is a poke war you win on the scoreboard but not the all-in. Keep stacking marks with Q and Electrical Surge autos, but respect Heroic Charge — a wall pin flips the fight, since she chains the stun into a Hammer Shock zone and out-trades your fragile body. At 6 Slicing Maelstrom is the spike: with her E down, your stun-lock lands first, and a mark mid-Keeper's Verdict cancels her channel outright.

edits.before: Bait your E-in or wait for you to step up, then E-pin you to a wall for a free stun and Q-knockup all-in
edits.after: Wait for you to step up, then Heroic Charge you into a wall for a free stun and a Hammer Shock all-in

notes: phases[1].rating stays 5/10 — it already reads as an even stage, so only the side/win pair is proposed for that row. Kit flag noted but not asserted: Hammer Shock carries a 'grounding' flag while Riot's description mentions only a slow and a delayed explosion, so no grounding claim was written. Whether Steadfast Presence interacts with Lightning Rush at all is not in the data; the page's existing 'her W is wasted against you' line rests on Lightning Rush not being a dash, which is what Riot's own text supports.
